The Player class represents thee characters in the game.

Variables:

health – The current health of the character.

Starts at 100. Once it reaches 0, we’re dead.

take_hit(damage)[source]¶

This method gets called when the player takes a hit from the opponent’s weapon :param damage: The damage dealt. This will be subtracted from :attr: health. :return: The new value of :attr: health.

Module contents¶

Demo Project: Game¶

This project serves mainly as an example project for `Pluralsight >http://www.pluralsight>`_ video course.

This idea is to simulate a very simpel role role-playing game where two characters fight. The gme mechanics are controlled by the game.Game class and the characters are :class: ~gamedemo.player.Player instance, each of which has a :class: ~gamedemo.weapons.Weapon to attack with.

The scenario we will try to simulate is of an old fashioned knight fighting a fire-breathing dragon.
